content_sections.text: Mechanical: Engineering Degree (full time course) in the respective discipline from recognized Indian University. Chemistry: B.Sc. (Chemistry) from a recognized Indian university.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for FAGMIL Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date for the FAGMIL Graduate Apprentice Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview for the Graduate Apprentice posts at FAGMIL is scheduled for 11 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they report to the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Graduate Apprentice posts?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Graduate Apprentice positions will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 12300/-. This is a fixed amount for the duration of the apprenticeship.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the FAGMIL Graduate Apprentice recruitment?
faq.answer: For the Mechanical post, an Engineering Degree in Mechanical is required. For the Chemistry post, a B.Sc. in Chemistry from a recognized university is necessary.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for Graduate Apprentices at FAGMIL?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Graduate Apprentice posts. 2 vacancies are for Mechanical and 1 vacancy is for Chemistry.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this FAGMIL recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for FAGMIL Graduate Apprentice posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the FAGMIL recruitment interview going to be held?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be held at FCI Aravali Gypsum and Minerals India, Jodhpur, Rajasthan, Pincode: 342011.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the FAGMIL Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, and any other relevant certificates as mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Graduate Apprentice posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Graduate Apprentice posts at FAGMIL will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contractual job for the position of Graduate Apprentice. The tenure is for the apprenticeship period as per FAGMIL's policy.
